evals.prompt: Match the right SageMaker Serverless Model Customization technique (`SFT`, `DPO`, `RLVR`, or `RLAIF`) to each of our 4 workloads in `us-east-1`: (1) teaching strict internal JSON schema output from 5,000 `(prompt, completion)` examples, (2) aligning tone using `(prompt, chosen, rejected)` human preference pairs, (3) improving SQL query generation where an automated test harness verifies execution accuracy, and (4) aligning helpfulness/safety using a written rubric without human preference labels.
evals.expected_output: Maps (1) `(prompt, completion)` supervised adaptation -> `SFT` (`SFTTrainer`), (2) `(prompt, chosen, rejected)` preference pairs -> `DPO` (`DPOTrainer`), (3) verifiable SQL/math/code tasks with deterministic/programmatic reward verification -> `RLVR` (`RLVRTrainer`), and (4) rubric/judge-guided alignment without human preference labels -> `RLAIF` (`RLAIFTrainer`), noting model-family recipe compatibility checks in SageMaker Hub before training.
expectations: Activates the aws-ai-ml skill
Correctly maps workload (1) to `SFT`, (2) to `DPO`, (3) to `RLVR`, and (4) to `RLAIF`
Explains the data/reward prerequisites and model-family Hub recipe support check for each trainer

evals.prompt: Our engineer prepared a single JSONL dataset with `{"prompt": "...", "completion": "..."}` rows and plans to reuse it unchanged for (a) Amazon Nova Micro SFT, (b) Qwen / Llama open-weights SFT, and (c) an `RLVR` training job. Audit the dataset format compatibility across all three targets.
evals.expected_output: Explains that `{"prompt", "completion"}` (`open_weights_sft` / `gpt_oss_sft`) works for supported open-weights SFT (alongside `messages` conversational `open_weights_sft_conv`), but FAILS for Amazon Nova SFT (`nova_sft` requires Converse-style `schemaVersion` / `system` / `messages` with `role` and `content` blocks) and FAILS for `RLVR` (`verl` format requires `data_source`, `prompt` message list, `ability`, and `reward_model` with `ground_truth`/`style` or `nova_rlvr` schema). Recommends running local schema validation before uploading to S3.
expectations: Activates the aws-ai-ml skill

Identifies that `{"prompt", "completion"}` is valid for open-weights SFT (`open_weights_sft`) but invalid for Amazon Nova SFT (`nova_sft` Converse `messages` format) and invalid for `RLVR` (`verl` / `nova_rlvr` reward schema)
Describes the required fields for Nova SFT (`system`/`messages` content blocks) and RLVR (`prompt`, `reward_model` / `ground_truth`) and recommends validating JSONL locally prior to S3 upload

evals.prompt: Review this serverless model evaluation plan in `us-west-2`: we are evaluating a fine-tuned `Amazon Nova Pro` checkpoint using LLM-as-Judge with 12 custom metrics; metric #1 has `instructions: "Score clinical accuracy from 1 to 3"` (no template variables), a 145-character `ratingScale[0].definition`, and mixes `{"floatValue": 1.0}` with `{"stringValue": "Pass"}` in the same `ratingScale`. Identify every blocker.
evals.expected_output: Flags all five blockers: (1) **Amazon Nova models do NOT support LLM-as-Judge or built-in scorers** in SageMaker serverless `model-evaluation` (must use deterministic/offline evaluation or a supported non-Nova target); (2) maximum **`10` `CustomMetric` entries** per evaluation (`12` exceeds the `1..10` limit); (3) `instructions` (`<= 5,000` chars) MUST include **`{{prompt}}` or `{{prediction}}`** template placeholders; (4) `ratingScale[].definition` must be **`<= 100` characters** (`145` exceeds limit); and (5) `ratingScale` values must be strictly **XOR `floatValue` OR `stringValue`** across all entries in a metric (never mix float and string scales).
expectations: Activates the aws-ai-ml skill
Flags that Amazon Nova models do NOT support LLM-as-Judge / built-in scorers in serverless `model-evaluation`

Catches all four custom metric schema violations: max `10` metrics (`1..10`), required `{{prompt}}` or `{{prediction}}` placeholder in `instructions` (`<= 5000` chars), `ratingScale[].definition <= 100` chars, and no mixing of `floatValue` and `stringValue`

Flags that SageMaker Inference Optimization / `start_benchmark` is not available in `ap-south-1` and identifies the supported regions (`us-west-2`, `us-east-1`, `ap-northeast-1`, `eu-west-1`)
